units.source_text: 父亲故去，我真正的少年时代也就宣告结束了。

en.t: With my father gone, my true boyhood also came to an end.

units.source_text: 我惊愕于自己的少年时代简直欠缺对人的应有的关心。

en.t: I was astonished to realize that my boyhood had been almost entirely lacking in the concern one ought to have for other people.

units.source_text: 而且，我甚至察觉自己对父亲的死毫不悲伤。

en.t: And I even noticed that I felt no sadness at all over my father's death.

units.source_text: 也许这称不上是什么惊愕，而是一种有气无力的感怀。

en.t: Perhaps it could hardly be called astonishment, but was instead a kind of listless reflection.
